hero.alt: Stone Sugar standing in a field by the water, black and white.

intro:
Two years with Stone Sugar, plus nights with Solis Armada. Festivals, bar stages, and the occasional open field.

Almost all of it is available light, which on a stage means whatever the wash happens to be doing that second. You learn the rig, then you wait.
